up: Retrieve compounds directly cited in document CHEMBL5726589, returning for each compound its ChEMBL identifier (CHEMBL ID) and the standardized chemical structure (canonical SMILES). No activity values, target names, assay details, or document provenance fields are requested; exclude any compound that is not explicitly referenced in the specified document. Ensure only compounds with a defined canonical SMILES are returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.chembl_id AS chembl_id, s.canonical_smiles FROM compounds c JOIN activity_records ar ON c.molregno = ar.molregno JOIN activity_parameters ap ON ar.activity_id = ap.activity_id WHERE ar.document_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726589' AND c.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM activity_records WHERE document_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726589') AND s.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;

up: Retrieve all compounds that appear in document CHEMBL5726589. For each compound, return its ChEMBL identifier (CHEMBL ID) and the canonical SMILES representation of its chemical structure. Only include compounds that have a non‑null canonical SMILES in the compound_structures table. No other filters, activity values, target names, or assay information are required.
sql: WITH document_compounds AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno FROM activities a WHERE a.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726589') ) SELECT DISTINCT c.chembl_id AS chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM document_compounds dc JOIN molecule_dictionary c ON dc.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
